text_en:
Maintenance Procedure Information System
 | Distribution Companies | Maintenance Procedures
Document No.:
 T-053-r1a | Equipment:
 Transformers of All Types — Pole-Mounted, Inside Room, Inside Kiosk
Issued to: 
 Distribution Companies
Status: 
 Approved
Approval date: 01 
 August 2006 | Procedure:
 Annual Maintenance 
 ( P1 - Y1 )
Next review date: August 2011
Introduction
This document sets out the periodic maintenance procedures P1, which must be carried out annually as indicated above by the code Y1, and the document was reviewed by the MPIS coordinator engineers of the distribution companies at the meeting of 28 September 2004 and updated on 1 August 2006.
This maintenance is carried out to return the transformers to a condition closest to the design condition of the transformer.
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order; maintenance personnel must carry the occupational safety and health category card.
Follow occupational safety and health procedures such as wearing a helmet and safety shoes, etc.
Ensure the supply source is disconnected from the transformer and ensure absence of voltage on it using a tested voltage indicator.
Ensure local earthing is applied to the transformer to be worked on.
Tools, Instruments and Equipment Used
Tested voltage indicator, tool bag, blower, Butagas cylinder for welding.
Cleaning brush and cloth pieces ('soft and clean').
Primer for painting the transformer, numbering machine for cables or transformers.
Spare lighting lamps for use inside the transformer kiosk or room.
Vehicle equipped with any means of communication.
Tested voltage indicator, tool bag, blower, Butagas cylinder for welding.
Cleaning brush and cloth pieces ('soft and clean').
Primer for painting the transformer, numbering machine for cables or transformers.
Spare lighting lamps for use inside the transformer kiosk or room.
Vehicle equipped with any means of communication.
Maintenance Steps to be Carried Out
Ensure the cleanliness of the transformer and the cleanliness and soundness of the insulators | 1.
Check the oil level and ensure there is no oil leakage from the transformer, and ensure the soundness of the gaskets or welds | 2.
Take an oil sample from the transformer to test it in the engineering laboratory and determine its suitability | 3.
Check the silica gel (replace it if saturated with moisture or if the original colour has changed to another colour) and check the oil breather | 4.
Check the quality of the transformer terminal connections | 5.
Ensure surge arresters are present on the pole-mounted transformer | 6.
Ensure the transformer earthing and the pole earthing are tightened (for the pole-mounted transformer) | 7.
Check the fixing of the transformer on the base | 8.
Record in the maintenance card | 9.
